Read the stored properties and helpers out loud: title, board size, cube face, coordinate correction, start tile, goal tile, blocked tiles, playable count, bounds check, and playable check. Those are the minimum facts needed for the first playable board.
At the end of this tutorial, SpriteKit still draws the tiles, but Foundation model types describe what those tiles mean and how large the current board is.
Keep drawing code and board model code in separate files. The separation makes the next rule step easier to follow.
